name: codex-live-canvas
description: A live visual canvas for Codex threads, feature nodes, diffs, tests, conflicts, and node-scoped follow-up chats.

interface.shortDescription: Track parallel Codex work as live feature nodes.
interface.longDescription: Codex Live Canvas packages a sync skill and MCP bridge so Codex threads can report feature status, changed files, tests, risks, conflicts, and node-scoped follow-up context to the cocanvas app.
defaultPrompt: Start a Live Canvas node for this task.
Update this feature node while you work.
Get context for this node follow-up.
